name: teambrain-vscode
description: Git-native, PR-governed team memory for AI coding agents. Registers the TeamBrain MCP server with Copilot agent mode — no config file.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: TeamBrain launches the `tb` CLI from this workspace, so it stays off until the workspace is trusted.

teambrain.enabled.description: Register the TeamBrain MCP server with agent mode. Turn off to disable the extension without uninstalling it.

teambrain.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the `tb` executable. Leave empty to use a workspace-local `node_modules/.bin/tb`, then `tb` on PATH.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with TeamBrain
walkthroughs.description: Shared, reviewable memory for your coding agents — in three steps.

steps.title: Install the tb CLI
steps.description:
TeamBrain runs as a local CLI; this extension only points agent mode at it.
[Install the CLI](command:teambrain.installCli)

steps.title: Create a brain
steps.description: Run `tb init` in your repo. It imports CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules and ADRs into `.teambrain/` on a branch — main is never touched.

steps.title: Check the server is registered
steps.description:
The status bar shows whether the MCP server is registered and how many brains it serves.
[Show status](command:teambrain.showStatus)

scripts.package: pnpm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies --out teambrain-vscode.vsix
